instruction: I am creating a presentation in LibreOffice Impress and need to make the slide numbers stand out. Please help me change the slide number color to green?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing slide number color to green in LibreOffice Impress. The evaluator checks if slide numbers in the master slide have green color formatting by examining the slideMaster1.xml file for srgbClr elements with green RGB values (green > red + threshold and green > blue + threshold).

llm_judge_reasons: The evaluator searches for ANY green color in the slide master XML, not specifically the slide number color
False positive risk: Will pass if any unrelated element (shape, text, background) in the master is green
Does not verify the color belongs to a slide number placeholder or field
XPath query './/a:solidFill//a:srgbClr' is too broad and lacks context about slide number elements
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Update XPath to specifically target slide number placeholder elements (e.g., find '<p:ph type="sldNum">' elements first)
Trace from slide number placeholders to their associated text/color formatting properties
Verify the color specifically applies to the slide number field, not just any element in the master
Consider examining the relationship between '<p:ph type="sldNum">' and its parent shape's color properties in the XML structure
